scope: Dragnar idle/attack torso synchronization only; source GLBs unchanged
cause: idle and attack animate chest while hips stays constant, leaving the lower torso/tail root behind the upper back
implementation: Move the existing chest rotation keys into hips as H*C*C0^-1 and keep chest at C0. Preserve interpolation, clip timing and every unrelated track. No translations or skeleton/rest/bind/weights/UV changes.
surface_provenance: Compared full-transfer helper v2 (240Hz interpolation approximation) against original clips; accepted v3 transfers source keys exactly. Final v3 dense unit, 12sec shin surface and six GPU images passed; max skin-palette coefficient difference to measured v2 was 0.0003492. No GLB surface/weights changed.
surface_limits: Existing internal folds remain. New overlap pairs can occur at joint folds; source fold depths improve for Fire/Light/Shadow; max increase for Gale/Stone/Tide below 0.009% region height. This is not a claim of intersection-free geometry.

gpu.comparison: left original, right final; orthographic rear 3/4; Fire and Light idle60, idle120, attack24; viewed all six: connected back/hips/tail, no visible shoulder-wing separation

not_tested: No complete match, Windows build, audio or release validation; these changes only concern Dragnar animations.
